Chalak dimaag qabr mein bhi roshni dhoondh leta hai.
Hum rahasya ki duniya me nakshe dhoondhte hain.
Manav aatma ek abodh jangli kshetra hai.
Dil wo wajehein jaanta hai jo tark ne kabhi nahi jaani.
Dil ek aisa dhokebaaz hai jo dimaag ki nahi sunta.
Gyaani sthitiyon ke anusaar khud ko dhal leta hai.
Teekha dimaag sach ka kila hai.
Buddhi insaani baat-cheet ka namak hai.
Man apani pinjara banata hai, phir rota hai.
Asthir man sada aandhi mein jeeta hai.
Hansi dukh ki kshanik mrityu hai.
Gyaan andhe ki aankh hai.
Insaani bhulbhulaiya ki koi master key nahi hai.
Jo apne krodh par kaabu rakhe, wahi beda chalata hai.
Jala hua bachcha aag se darta hai.
Chalak dhokebaaz moorkhon ka mukut pehenta hai.
Hum bandar ki suraksha ke liye apni azadi bechte hain.
Anand saral saans mein mile.
Hum hawa ke peeche bhagte hain aur sirf dhool paate hain.
Ek prasann hriday cheekhte toofaan ka mazak udata hai.
Buddhi gusse wale devtaon ka krodh shaant karti hai.
Dil ek aisa kila hai jise todna mushkil hai.
Jaise hum aage badhte hain, dimaag ka kshitij peeche hatta hai.
Har deewar ek intezaar karti darwaaza hai.
Tohfe mein mile ghode ke daant nahi ginne chahiye.
Ek teekhi baat vichar ka gehna hai.
Buddhi pareshaan dimaag mein dhoop ki kiran hai.
Teekhi buddhi sabse tez barbaadi se aage nikal jaati hai.
Vyang wo chingari hai jo geeli baati ko jalati hai.
Ek teekha nireekshak marmar ki deewaron ke aar-paar dekhta hai.
Gyan apni agyanta ki gehrai ko janana hai.
Dil ek purane taal par dhadakta hai.
Gyan wo langar hai jo shak me bhi mazboot rehta hai.
Ek chatur jeebh talwar ki dhaar par naachti hai.
Tark darshanik ka kavach hai.
Khud ko jaanana hi devataon par vijay hai.
Ek chalak dhokha pavitra mukhote ke peeche chhupta hai.
Rooh bhooli hui riyasaton ke geet gaati hai.
Buddhi dar se zang laga hua disha suchak hai.
Sab kuch badal raha hai; kuch sthir nahi.
Rooh kismat ke tarashe raaston par chalti hai.
Pahad ko suno, hawa ko nahi.
Lalach rajaon ko dimaag ka bhikari bana deta hai.
Teekha dimaag maya ke aar-paar nikal jata hai.
Dhan gyaani ka daas, moorh ka swami hai.
Buddhi badal wale dimaag mein dhoop hai.
Buddhi tez vichar ki khubsurti hai.
